name: io.github.edgarfloresguerra2011-a11y/marketnow-mcp
title: MarketNow — Trust Layer for Agent Commerce
description: Trust layer for agent commerce. 8,760 MCP-compatible skills with Sentinel L2 security audits (L1.5 + L1.6 + L2 v2.0 + L2.5 gVisor), x402 payments (HTTP 402 + USDC on Base), and AP2 delegated mandates. Human-in-the-loop by default. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search 8,760 MCP skills by query, category, price, language, or sentinel score

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get full details: system prompt, sentinel report, setup, install command

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 58 skill categories with counts

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get npx install command for a skill

transport_note: stdio only (npx -y marketnow-mcp). HTTP/SSE transport is on the roadmap — see https://marketnow.site/trust. The previously-declared remote URL https://marketnow.site/api/mcp was never deployed and has been removed.
